correctness.rationale: A complete 11-vertex modular construction, exhaustive 242/231/252-face enumerations and acyclic discrete Morse matchings with 110/106/117 pairs yield integral sphere wedges of ranks 21/18/17. Two exact relative elementary-collapse certificates, with 4 pairs leaving three triangles and 10 pairs leaving one tetrahedron, give cofibers wedge^3 S2 and S3. Long exact integral sequences prove primitive injection versus primitive surjection. A 55-element affine orbit proves all arcs equivalent. Standalone standard-library verifier reconstructed and replayed all computations, checked matching DAG acyclicity and independently checked mod-2 ranks; no extrapolation.

value.rationale: A standard doubly regular tournament exhibits opposite, structurally different homology-map responses to deleting versus reversing exactly one arc: primitive rank-three loss under restoration, and primitive rank-one kernel under reversal. The full 55-arc symmetry scope and explicit relative cofibers make this a motivated topological fault-stability benchmark beyond a routine face count.
